name: selective_state_update
description: Mamba selective state update. For each (b,h,p), dt' = softplus(dt + dt_bias) when dt_softplus is true (otherwise dt + dt_bias when dt_bias is present, else dt); dA = exp(dt' * A); new_state = state*dA + (x*dt')*B, where B/C are repeat-interleaved from ngroups to nheads by ratio = nheads//ngroups. y = sum_n(new_state*C) + D*x, then y = y * z * sigmoid(z) when z is present. state is [batch,nheads,dim,dstate], x/dt are [batch,nheads,dim], B/C are [batch,ngroups,dstate], D/dt_bias are [nheads,dim] or None, z is [batch,nheads,dim] or None, and A is either [nheads,dim,dstate] or [nheads,dstate]. Returns (y in x.dtype, out_state in state.dtype) as two newly allocated tensors; the input state tensor is not modified. D, z and dt_bias are optional and dt_softplus defaults to False. Suites exercise bfloat16 state/x/dt/B/C/z with float32 A/D/dt_bias, including missing D/z/dt_bias and ngroups>1.
